19.description: Saskatoon will provide $13,517.50 over three years for exterior painting and wood pillar repairs at the designated Larkin House (925 5th Avenue North).

chips.text: Approved
Councillor questioned if pillar repairs were sufficient for long-term preservation.
Council questioned repair depth; staff relied on contractor expertise.
Unclear if proposed pillar repairs address structural integrity or just surface issues.
Staff committed to assisting owner if unforeseen issues require more funding.

8.description: The Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee discussed clarifying the Civic Heritage Policy, including intangible heritage and barriers to property designation, and reviewed city artifacts.

chips.text: Recommended
Councillor linked intangible heritage discussions to Indigenous reconciliation efforts.
Cobblestones from 11th Street will be used for a patio at the Mars residence.
Committee members were confused about past feedback on civic heritage policy.
Staff will report back on intangible heritage and policy language in June.

9.description: Saskatoon's Civic Heritage Policy (c10-020) is under review, with administration directed to prioritize parts of the Heritage Plan with the Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee.

chips.text: Approved
Committee members expressed confusion regarding the attached heritage policy documents.
Property owners with designated heritage properties are affected by policy changes.
Whether intangible heritage should be included in the policy remains unclear.

10.description: The committee reviewed its current statement of expenditures, noting minimal spending to date, and discussed potential future spending for conferences and heritage awards.

chips.text: Received as information
Councillors discussed sending three members to a National Trust conference.
The committee questioned the cost and collaboration for heritage awards.
Staff will draft a letter for three members to attend a conference.

22.description: The Committee approved sending members to the 2026 National Trust Conference in the Waterloo region, noting three members attended in 2025.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor suggested approving funding for three members due to meeting schedule.
Up to three committee members will attend the conference.

12.description: Council received updates on committee activities, including participation in a city volunteer event, online workshops, and a heritage fair.

chips.text: Received as information

21.description: A committee member provided an update on attending Ministry online workshops and judging youth projects at the Heritage Fair held at the Western Development Museum.

chips.text: Recommended
